She has purple eyes with white sclera and purple irises, and three rounded yellow markings on her stomach; each is longer the further down her stomach it is. Despite her carnivorous nature: at best, she has rounded teeth like a cow's; at worst, she has gums, because she mostly swallows her prey whole without chewing.
